front: What does binary search need from the array it searches?
Why can binary search discard half of the range?
back: Every element in that half is on the wrong side of the middle one, because the array is sorted.

front: How is the middle index of the range lo to hi computed?
back: mid = (lo + hi) // 2, the floor of the middle.

front: What is the largest number of probes for n elements?
How many probes does a million elements take at most?
How does the worst case change when the array doubles?
What does a lower-bound search return when no element qualifies?
back: The length of the array, an index that means none.
